title: Skew tolerance: fires inside the elicited window are onTime; outside record cronSkewed with delta
asA: operator observing the timeliness of scheduled work on a Worker
iWant: the dispatcher to classify every fire against the elicited skew window and record cronSkewed for late fires with the delta
soThat: the applied logging companion surfaces cron drift as a first-class signal without every handler having to keep its own clock

acceptanceCriteria.description: With skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock aligned to scheduledTime, dispatching a scheduled event fires cronFired with {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: onTime, duration: >=0} on the sink; no cronSkewed event fires for that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock aligned to scheduledTime
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronFired event fires with outcome onTime and no cronSkewed fires

acceptanceCriteria.description: With skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced 60000ms past scheduledTime, dispatching a scheduled event fires cronSkewed with {event, expression, scheduledTime, outcome: skewed, duration: >=0, deltaMs: 60000} on the sink; the routed handler still runs to completion.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher configured with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced 60000ms past scheduledTime
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronSkewed event fires with the observed delta and the handler still runs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Boundary at exactly skewToleranceMs: with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced EXACTLY 30000ms past scheduledTime, dispatch classifies onTime (inclusive boundary) and fires cronFired with outcome:"onTime"; no cronSkewed record emits for that dispatch.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock at scheduledTime + 30000ms
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronFired event fires with outcome:"onTime" and no cronSkewed emits

acceptanceCriteria.description: One millisecond past skewToleranceMs: with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock advanced 30001ms past scheduledTime, dispatch classifies skewed and fires cronSkewed with deltaMs:30001; the routed handler still runs to completion.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock at scheduledTime + 30001ms
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronSkewed event fires with deltaMs:30001 and the handler runs

acceptanceCriteria.description: Early fire (clock BEFORE scheduledTime): with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock 5000ms before scheduledTime, dispatch classifies onTime and fires cronFired with outcome:"onTime"; no cronSkewed record emits and no negative deltaMs ever lands on the sink (the skew signal is lateness-only).
acceptanceCriteria.given: a dispatcher with skewToleranceMs=30000 and a clock at scheduledTime - 5000ms
acceptanceCriteria.then: a cronFired event fires with outcome:"onTime" and no cronSkewed emits with a negative deltaMs
